meta.title: Salem Tamil Roots | Millet foods and herbal wellness from Salem
meta.description: Traditional millet foods, Menmai millet brownies and herbal wellness products, made in Salem, Tamil Nadu.

home.heroText: Millet foods, Menmai brownies and herbal wellness from Salem, made the way our grandmothers did, packed for the way we live now.
home.categoriesText: From millet snacks to herbal care
home.storyTitle: Grains our grandparents grew up on
home.storyText: Ragi, kambu, kavuni rice and cholam fed Tamil families for generations. We turn them into foods people actually crave, like Menmai millet brownies, so tradition stays on the table.
